cypher:
MATCH (cp:Counterparty)-[:IS_COMPANY]->(c:Company)
MATCH path=(c)-[:SUBSIDIARY_OF*0..]->(parent:Company)<-[o:OWNS]-(p:Person)
WHERE o.pct >= 25
AND EXISTS {
  MATCH (:WatchlistEntry)-[:MATCHES]->(p)
}
RETURN DISTINCT cp.id AS counterparty, p.id AS person, p.name AS person_name, o.pct AS ownership_pct
ORDER BY cp.id, o.pct DESC LIMIT 100

cypher:
MATCH (cp:Counterparty)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r1:CreditRating)
WITH cp, r1
ORDER BY r1.rated_on DESC
WITH cp, collect(r1) AS ratings
WHERE size(ratings) >= 2
WITH cp, ratings[0] AS latest, ratings[1] AS previous
WHERE latest.investment_grade = false AND latest.rating_rank > previous.rating_rank AND latest.rated_on >= '2026-07-20'
RETURN cp.id AS counterparty, latest.agency AS agency, latest.rating AS current_rating, latest.rated_on AS rated_on, previous.rating AS previous_rating, previous.rated_on AS previous_rated_on
ORDER BY latest.rated_on DESC LIMIT 100

cypher:
MATCH (cp:Counterparty)-[:HAS_LIMIT]->(cl:CreditLimit)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Trade {status: 'open'})-[:WITH]->(cp)
WITH cp, cl, coalesce(sum(t.mtm_eur), 0) AS exposure_raw
WITH cp, cl, CASE WHEN exposure_raw > 0 THEN exposure_raw ELSE 0 END AS exposure
WHERE exposure > cl.limit_eur
RETURN cp.id AS counterparty, exposure, cl.limit_eur AS credit_limit
ORDER BY exposure DESC LIMIT 100

cypher:
MATCH (t:Trade)-[:WITH]->(cp:Counterparty)
WITH cp, sum(t.notional_eur) AS cp_notional
MATCH (t2:Trade)
WITH cp, cp_notional, sum(t2.notional_eur) AS total_notional
RETURN cp.id AS counterparty, cp.name AS name, cp_notional / total_notional AS share_of_notional
ORDER BY share_of_notional DESC
LIMIT 1
